item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:50 HKT 28/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong easterly airstream will affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring rainy weather to the region. With the easterly airstream moderating, it will be mild, humid and brighter over the coastal areas in the middle and latter parts of this week. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China over the weekend.

Date/Month: 29/01 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Rather cool in the morning. One or two rain patches later.
Temp range: 14 - 17 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
